subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Friendship is one of (i) foundation of the noblest friendship, it is a boon Column A Column B and divine gift (b) It is a relation (ii) existed between two similar minds and like minded persons (c) Since sincerity and (iii) are relevant aspects loyalty are the belonging to this lead a man to develop or establish friendship (d) It is an intimacy or (iv) existed between hearts an acquaintance (e) Confidence, love, (v) available in painful sacrifice, fellow periods feeling, mental state (vi) expressions of human relations and instincts (vii) withdraws friendship from life
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (vi) Friendship is one of the noblest expressions of human relations and instincts. (b) + (ii) It is a relation existed between two similar minds and like minded persons. (c) + (i) Since sincerity and loyalty are the foundation of friendship, it is a boon and divine gift.
